newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina sees letter of intent with IMF soon.
newsitem.headline: Argentina sees letter of intent with IMF soon.

text.p: Economy Minister Roque Fernandez said Friday he expected Argentina to sign a letter of intent with the International Monetary Fund "soon".
Fernandez told reporters he was scheduled to meet with President Carlos Menem and IMF Managing Director Michel Camdessus Sunday night in Buenos Aires to discuss progress of negotiations.
"We will have a letter of intent with the IMF soon because a series of positive elements" are ahead, like proposed tax increases, he said.
The tax measures are designed to close an increasing budget gap and are expected to receive legislative approval before the end of September.
The letter will outline the Argentine government's commitments on economic variables such as fiscal targets.
